explication: WP Rocket is a WordPress performance plugin: its primary workflow configures caching and delivery optimizations, then serves transformed pages and assets to site visitors. The tree also shows CDN management, critical-CSS and above-the-fold media handling, admin settings, scheduled work, insights, and compatibility integrations. Sampled code confirms cache purging, CDN state management, Critical CSS file handling, and WordPress hook registration; some broader feature links reflect the README and directory structure rather than inspected implementations.
